## 2025-04-27 - [High Priority] Add Salted Password Hashing
**Vulnerability:** Passwords were saved using unsalted SHA-256 hashes in `LocalAuthService`. This means that attackers who obtain the hashes could use rainbow tables to efficiently crack weak passwords, or quickly identify users sharing the same password.
**Learning:** Even though encryption was applied (SHA-256), the lack of a salt makes hashes vulnerable. Simple hashing is an incomplete defense mechanism.
**Prevention:** Always append or prepend a unique, cryptographically secure string (salt) generated by `Random.secure()` to each user's password prior to hashing, and store the salt alongside the hash.
